scope: Ideal liquid properties, component transport, regular-grid conservative feedback, representative breakup/splitting, boundary budgets, composition checkpoints and reacting-flow stepping APIs.
boundary: No excess mixing energy, mixture wall impact/KH shed children or CLI/injection integration yet. Uses PeleF carrier molecular weight, binary harmonic diffusion and existing heat-transfer convention rather than full upstream coefficient parity.
rate_rule: Effective D=sum(X_surface_i*D_i)/sum(X_surface_i); component share=X_surface_i*D_i/sum(X_surface_j*D_j), common Stefan transfer with existing selectable Ranz-Marshall/Abramzon-Sirignano correlations.
